implement_sweeper_plugin: implement a custom Hydra Sweeper subclass that overrides setup and sweep methods for multi-job execution
override_sweep_method: override the sweep method in a Sweeper subclass to execute jobs with different command line arguments
override_setup_method: override the setup method in a Sweeper subclass to initialize hydra_context, task_function, and config
validate_batch_is_legal: validate a batch of sweep override sequences to ensure they can be composed before launching jobs
review_sweeper_class: review the abstract Sweeper class and its setup, sweep, and validate_batch_is_legal methods
